神行百变小木桑.en: Imhotep has a lesson in footwork. He expects you to keep up.
神行百变小木桑.zh-CN: 伊姆霍特普准备教几步身法，希望你能跟得上。

木桑道人传授袁承志神行百变绝技。.en: Learned footwork from Imhotep at Highbridge.
木桑道人传授袁承志神行百变绝技。.zh-CN: 在高桥城向伊姆霍特普学习步法。

袁承志单挑归辛树胜利。.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯独自赢下索贝克的考验。

description.en: Grants an evasion check: 15% at 80% Health or above; 7% below.
description.zh-CN: 提供一次闪避判定：生命至少80%时概率15%，低于80%时概率7%。

description.en: With Primal Mastery equipped, increases Defense used against incoming attacks by 50%. Adds 25 percentage points to Primal Palm's critical-hit chance.
description.zh-CN: 装备原初专精时，受到攻击的伤害结算防御提高50%。原初掌的暴击概率增加25个百分点。

description.en: On Gauntlet hits, may inflict Stunned for 2 turns (base 25% chance). Other talents can raise the chance; unprotected allies may also be affected.
description.zh-CN: 拳套命中后可使目标晕眩2回合，基础触发率25%；其他天赋可提高概率，未受保护的友方也可能受影响。

text.en: Horus. Still practicing, or have you started letting your reputation do the work?
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯。还在练习吗，还是已经开始靠名气出手了？

text.en: Practicing. My reputation is a poor substitute for footwork.
text.zh-CN: 还在练。名气可替不了脚下的功夫。

text.en: Good. Those masked raiders have been preying on travelers. Show me what you've learned.
text.zh-CN: 很好。那些蒙面劫匪一直在袭击旅人，让我看看你学到了什么。

text.en: Good. I hear you and Sobek have a disagreement to settle.
text.zh-CN: 不错。听说你和索贝克还有点分歧要解决。

text.en: He thinks I've been neglecting Thoth's lessons.
text.zh-CN: 他觉得，我把托特教的本领荒废了。

text.en: Then show him you haven't. I'll take the blame for any bruised pride.
text.zh-CN: 那就让他看看。要是谁的自尊受了伤，算我的。

text.en: I'd rather he took the bruises.
text.zh-CN: 我还是希望挨打的能是他。

text.en: That is not helping.
text.zh-CN: 你这可帮不上忙。

text.en: Then let me help. Watch my feet, both of you.
text.zh-CN: 那就让我来帮忙。你们两个，看好我的脚步。

text.en: (Imhotep slips past a fallen cart without breaking stride.)
text.zh-CN: （伊姆霍特普掠过一辆翻倒的马车，脚步没有丝毫停顿。）

text.en: You barely touched the ground.
text.zh-CN: 你的脚几乎都没碰到地。

text.en: (You pay very close attention.)
text.zh-CN: （你看得格外认真。）

text.en: Keep moving, and pay attention. Sobek will make you earn it.
text.zh-CN: 保持脚步，留心观察。索贝克可不会让你轻松过关。

text.en: I suppose the lesson isn't over yet.
text.zh-CN: 看来，这堂课还没结束。

text.en: There you are. Sekhmet and I have other matters to attend to. Let's see your stance.
text.zh-CN: 你们来了。塞赫美特和我还有别的事要办。让我看看你的架势。

text.en: (Sobek lowers his guard.) Wait.
text.zh-CN: （索贝克放低双手。）等等。

text.en: I'm listening.
text.zh-CN: 你说。

text.en: Thoth, you can come out now. I recognize your training.
text.zh-CN: 托特，可以出来了。我认得你教的招式。

text.en: Good. At least one of you is paying attention.
text.zh-CN: 很好。至少有一个人在认真观察。

text.en: I was paying attention. Mostly to not getting hit.
text.zh-CN: 我也很认真。主要在认真躲拳头。

text.en: Horus, your companion has been helping. Face Sobek alone this time. I want to see what you can do.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，你的同伴一直在帮忙。这次独自面对索贝克，让我看看你的本领。

text.en: I'll supervise from a safer distance.
text.zh-CN: 那我就在安全一点的地方督战。

text.en: Yes, teacher.
text.zh-CN: 是，老师。

text.en: (Sobek changes from a rush to a solid guard. Horus finally sees the rhythm.)
text.zh-CN: （索贝克从猛攻转为稳守，荷鲁斯终于看清了其中的节奏。）

text.en: That's it. Primal Palm and Gemshatter Fist fit together.
text.zh-CN: 原来如此。原初掌与碎玉拳，正好能互相配合。

text.en: (Even through the bruises, Horus follows the rhythm of Sobek's strikes.)
text.zh-CN: （虽然挨了不少拳，荷鲁斯还是跟上了索贝克出招的节奏。）

text.en: I see where I went wrong. I can build on this.
text.zh-CN: 我明白错在哪儿了。接下来，可以在这个基础上继续练。
